# Sales Performance Dashboard

This Tableau Public project analyzes sales, profit, customers, discounts, and delivery performance.

## Dashboard Features

- Sales trend over time
- Sales vs profit comparison
- 3-month moving average of sales
- Orders per customer
- Average delivery time by ship mode
- Top customers contributing to 80% of sales
- Sales and profit by product sub-category
- Discount vs profit analysis
- Delivery time by region

## Tools Used

- Tableau Public
- Superstore sales dataset

## Goal

The goal of this project is to understand sales performance, identify profitable products and customers, and find areas to improve delivery and discount strategies.
